mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing nortriptyline levels; additionally, progestins can enhance CNS depression and may affect tricyclic antidepressant metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline adverse effects (dry mouth, sedation, urinary retention); consider nortriptyline level monitoring or dose adjustment if excessive effects emerge.
